content.description:
Pushing power to the edges. Building open-source technology for the future of decentralized global finance.

Collaboration and community building is at the core of the Blink Labs culture. Bringing about the next generation of financial software will need to be a collaboration between an ever changing landscape of diverse parties each with their own thoughts and goals. Establishing open and honest communication empowers community participation which fosters personal accountability. We want to make that simpler for all.
